citations.assessment: Pesachim gives Yehoshua, son of Rav Idi, dispatched by the rabbis and finding Rav Kahana already dead. It lacks bar Avin Naggara. The narrator’s correction in both particulars is supported.

holds.reason: Pesachim names Yehoshua son of Rav Idi and omits the extra names. Preserve the full heading and the text’s immediate objection.

notes.text: Pesachim gives Yehoshua son of Rav Idi finding Kahana already dead. Preserve the full printed heading and the immediate objection to both the name and death presence.
